title: Use the orders board
summary: See orders in columns by stage, move them by dragging and choose which cards show first.

steps.title: Menu → Clinic History → Lab Orders
steps.details: The jobs sent to external labs and the stage each one is in.

steps.title: Drag the card
steps.details: Drop it on another column to change its stage. If that stage needs a lab or a due date, a window opens with the date already proposed. On a phone, use Move to, in the card’s menu.

steps.title: Sort by
steps.details: Decides which cards show first in each column. Scrolling down a column loads the next ones on its own.
